name: Snaketongue Celebrant
tactics: The celebrant uses coils of despair to restrain foes, saving serpent’s lash for enemies that its allies cannot reach easily. In melee combat, the celebrant prefers to fight in serpent form.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

hit.description: damage (crit 2d8 + 11), and the snaketongue celebrant makes a secondary attack

powers.name: Serpent's Lash
powers.flavorText: a whip of amber-colored energy lashes the target

hit.description: psychic damage, and the target grants combat advantage to all of its enemies until the end of the yuan-ti celebrant’s next turn
the target is restrained (save ends) by writhing coils of green energy

effect.description: The snaketongue assassin transforms into a crushgrip constrictor. Any equipment the assassin is carrying merges with the new form. The assassin uses the crushgrip constrictor’s statistics instead its own, except for hit points. Reverting to its true form is a minor action.
